item.description: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down reports of a second security breach involving Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) and what it reveals about the growing cybersecurity threats facing AI companies. Ahamadeen examines how startup Cathedral allegedly exploited third-party data from Salesforce (CRM) to access Anthropic's Slack workspace, raising serious questions about data security, third-party vulnerabilities, and the risks of an increasingly interconnected AI ecosystem.
item.title: Why Anthropic's second hack exposes a growing AI security crisis

item.description: A months-old start-up founded by former DOGE staffers used AI agents to get inside Anthropic through third-party business software, reaching meeting transcripts, salaries and Slack messages. item.title: Anthropic got hacked again, and this time we know who did it
